about: Free resources for learning before, during and between classes.
steps: Learn one language. Python reads most like English, but Java, C, C++, JavaScript and Go are all good first choices. A 100-level course counts.
Get comfortable with loops and recursion. They're useful tools for solving many programming problems.
Pick something you'd want to build, then read about people who built something like it: their problems, their tools, their words.
